description: This file defines utility functions for interacting with a backend API, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), handling authentication headers, and specific functions for managing work items and comments within a project management context.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines whether a given API path is public (no Authorization required), specifically '/auth/login' and '/auth/signup'.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers for requests, conditionally adding the Authorization header for protected paths.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, manages user logout on 401 errors for protected routes, and throws errors with relevant messages.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend, attaching auth headers for protected endpoints, parses JSON response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend, with automatic auth header attachment, handles response parsing and errors.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters, ensuring proper URL encoding, auto-attaching auth headers.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend with auth headers, handles response and errors.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item using a GET request.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage and allowing override.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, including author creation info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a complete URL for a given API path based on current base URL.
